title: DGTEN: A Robust Deep Gaussian based Graph Neural Network for Dynamic Trust Evaluation with Uncertainty-Quantification Support
reasoning: The paper focuses on computational trust evaluation within network graphs for cybersecurity purposes, using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), and Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs). It does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
